wish: someone should make a storybook program where parents can change the pictures but not the text
spec:
A picture book maker: write the words for each page, then lock the text so it can no longer be edited.
Once locked, every page still lets you add, change or remove its picture from the phone's photos; read it full screen with Back and Next.
It does not print, share or sync; the book and its shrunk photos live only in this browser's storage.

type.text: The little bear goes to the sea.

notes: Text unlock needs a deliberate double tap. Photos are downscaled to 900px JPEG to fit localStorage; a quota error shows one line.
